stages.content:
| Stage | Next stage and exit condition |
| --- | --- |
| Prepare | Review only after the request is readable and complete |
| Review | Complete only after the designated caller judgment is recorded |

Prepare collects and validates the request; Review assesses completeness and records the explicit decision. Input existence alone cannot establish review completion.

fields.stages: Prepare collects and validates the request; Review assesses completeness and records a decision.
fields.transitions: Prepare enters Review only after a readable, complete request; Review completes only after the designated caller judgment is recorded.
fields.exit_gates: Prepare requires a readable, complete request; Review requires an explicit judgment by the designated caller.

behavior.content: Factory initialization is a prerequisite. The flow then advances only through the declared stages when their exit gates are satisfied; initialization alone is not completion.

fields.behavior: Validate Plan and construct the first-stage Run, then execute stage input checks and guarded transitions in order.
fields.invariants: Invalid Plan produces no Run; incomplete Prepare cannot enter Review; absent recorded judgment cannot complete the flow.

trace.content: The context model and planned cases are review inputs, not proof of implementation.

fields.model_elements: Package Example supplies participant context only; it declares no sample-flow realization.
fields.requirements_links: Requirement allocation remains an author review item; this example claims no approved requirement.
fields.verification_links: Planned checks cover empty plans, repeated stages, first-stage initialization, rejection of incomplete Prepare and rejection of completion without recorded gate judgment; none has executed.
